hc.name: herdr-core
hc.why: runs every terminal; mods read and write them through it

git.name: Git
git.why: the Git dialog, branches in the sidebar, worktrees

sh.name: POSIX shell
sh.why: bounded Git output, partial patches and interactive rebase in the Git mod
sh.fix: Use the system sh on macOS/Linux, or add Git for Windows' sh to PATH

mise.name: mise
mise.why: installing the programs below that it owns

lific.name: lific
lific.fix: git clone git@github.com:raphaelmans/lific.git && cd lific/web && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run build && cd .. && cargo build --release --locked && ln -sf "$PWD/target/release/lific" ~/.local/bin/lific

wt.name: Worktrunk
wt.why: worktrees from the Launcher, the Worktrunk page

jq.name: jq
jq.why: model sync, the Launcher's reading of each agent's own settings

curl.name: curl
curl.fix: It comes with macOS at /usr/bin/curl: check PATH

auto-title.name: Auto Title service
auto-title.fix: Open Auto Title (cmd-alt-t): it installs its own copy

gh.name: GitHub CLI
gh.why: organizations, repositories and pull requests on this computer

fd.name: fd
fd.why: listing files for Find a file

rg.name: ripgrep
rg.why: listing files for Find a file when fd is not here

acli.name: Atlassian CLI
acli.fix: brew tap atlassian/homebrew-acli && brew install acli
